Name: Hermogenes
Role: One who turned away from Paul in Asia
Summary: Hermogenes was one of those in Asia who turned away from Paul, named with Phygellus in 2 Timothy.
KeyStory: Hermogenes was one of those in Asia who turned away from Paul, named with Phygellus in 2 Timothy.
LifeLesson: When many turn away, the few who stay shine the brighter.
